issues.title: No lifetime endpoint for the negative case
issues.detail: Past nonconception and lifelong nonconception are the author's judgment; no independently verified history or lifetime follow-up is given in the admitted case.

issues.title: Symptoms and five marks belong to one retrospective case
issues.detail: The mole/scar confirmation and symptoms are narrated by Lilly, with no separate blinded elicitation or independent case denominator. They do not establish clinical validity.

issues.title: Natal override needs its own source-complete natal procedure
issues.detail: The precedence statement is explicit; this horary span does not supply a complete natal barrenness algorithm or the1635 querent's nativity.

issues.title: First-question resemblance lacks counts
issues.detail: Usually/often is not accompanied by a denominator, comparison distribution or independently checkable series; the Gemini example is illustrative.

issues.title: Moon-versus-Jupiter hour ruler
issues.detail: The figure's day/hour brace shows Moon; the table counts Jupiter as hour ruler and separately its masculine sign. Retain both without choosing a repair. A coherent two-row hour-chain substitution is an analyst sensitivity calculation, not Lilly's alternative judgment.

issues.title: Four-minute solar mismatch
issues.detail: Question figure Sun 27°52′ differs from the27°48′ used for the later perfect-square claim. Exact geometry gives a4′ mismatch; no change is made to the source.

issues.title: 1635 chart is transcribed, not independently recomputed
issues.detail: Several signs are inferred from diagram placement. Printed third/ninth cusps retain Libra19°20′ and Aries19°10′. Terms, application and source judgment are not ephemeris-validated by a static replay.

issues.title: Mercury minutes come from the later table
issues.detail: The figure gives Mercury 11 degrees with no minutes. The later calculation prints11°00′; preserve the missing figure field and explicit second witness rather than silently zero-filling.

issues.title: Twelve testimonies are not independent evidence
issues.detail: The table reuses Mercury, Saturn, Moon, Jupiter, sign and house roles. Its8:4 plurality is a literal table count, not calibrated probability or an independent-observation denominator.

issues.title: House-gender votes and cusp virtue
issues.detail: Moon and Saturn lie in geometric sectors4 and8 but within5° before cusps5 and9. The earlier cusp-virtue rule is a plausible qualification, not an explicitly stated resolution here. Preserve geometry, source votes and inference separately.

issues.title: Unspecified time/calendar and unverified historical transits
issues.detail: The source labels dates and P.M. times but these pages do not state modern timezone, exact observation location, Gregorian conversion or birth-hour inputs. Same-calendar date subtraction is distinct from an ephemeris calculation.

issues.title: About fourteen weeks is not a frozen exact target
issues.detail: The local one-week-per-degree rule is explicit, but the averaging/rounding/selection rule and prior tolerance for about are not. Do not optimize a conversion against the known11 July report.

issues.title: Reported birth-day transits are retrospective support
issues.detail: Mars/Ascendant, Mercury/Moon, Sun square and Moon/Mercury statements appear after the reported birth date, without separate advance freezes or external corroboration; they are not four new predictions.
